notes: Mid-market product team building in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows), high focus on consistent latency and token cost control
Primary workload: chat/agent (streaming responses + tool-calling) for step-by-step onboarding guidance
Initial plan: prove on Hosted API (fast time-to-value) -> move to Dedicated for predictable throughput & isolation
Latency SLO: p95 target 250-350ms for single-turn streaming in US region; p50 ~120ms desired
Cost constraints: strict token budget per user flow, want built-in token caps and per-route cost controls
Tool-calling: needs secure webhook/tool integrations, prefer server-side tool run with structured function call output
SE notes: suggested batching small (auto) + streaming enabled; recommend KV prefix caching for repeat flows
Security asks: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs, ability to use customer-managed KMS, data residency options
Quote from head of product: 'We need the copilot to feel instant — even during multi-step tool calls. Latency variance kills UX.'
POC metrics to deliver: p95 latency under 350ms, token cost per session < $0.10 (target), robust function-calling examples
Open questions: SLA for streaming endpoints, Dedicated pricing bands for reserved GPUs, migration path from Hosted to Dedicated without code changes
use_case_summary: Pathfinder Labs wants an in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows) using chat/agent models. They will evaluate Hosted API to validate UX and latency, with streaming + function-calling for tool integrations. If benchmarks meet SLOs, they will pursue Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Key requirements: consistent p95 latency (250-350ms), token cost caps per flow, SOC2/KMS/audit capabilities, simple migration path. POC to include latency benchmarks, cost reporting, and a demo of secure tool-calling.
